messages.content: 去年現代藝術博物館的會員們有多頻繁地參觀？

function.name: most_frequent_visitor
function.description: Retrieve the visitor who visited the museum the most within a given period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start_date.description: The start date of the period, format: yyyy-mm-dd.

end_date.description: The end date of the period, format: yyyy-mm-dd.

minimum_visits.description: The minimum number of visits to qualify. Default: 1

message.content:
我想確認一下您的需求：  
- 您是想知道「所有會員在去年（2023 年）平均每人參觀了多少次」嗎？  
- 還是想知道「會員中最常參觀的人（即訪問次數最多的會員）以及他/她的訪問次數」？  

如果您需要的是前者，我目前沒有整體會員訪問統計的資料；如果是後者，我可以使用內建的函式來查詢「最頻繁訪問者」並提供其訪問次數。請告訴我您更偏好的資訊！
message.reasoning: The user asks: "去年現代藝術博物館的會員們有多頻繁地參觀？" Means: "How frequently did members of the Museum of Contemporary Art visit last year?" They want frequency of visits by members. We have a function to retrieve the visitor who visited the museum the most within a given period. But they want frequency of members. We might need to call function with museum_name "現代藝術博物館" (Museum of Contemporary Art). Period: last year. So start_date: 2023-01-01, end_date: 2023-12-31. Minimum_visits maybe default 1. But function returns the most frequent visitor. That doesn't answer the question. We need to compute average visits per member? The function only gives most frequent visitor. We might need to approximate or explain limitation. We can ask clarifying question: do they want average visits per member? Or distribution? We can provide best we can: use function to get most frequent visitor and mention that we don't have data for all members. But maybe we can call function to get most frequent visitor and then say that members visited on average X times? But we don't have data. We could ask for clarification. Probably better to ask clarifying question.
